extracted.intended_audience: USPTO patent examiners and patent practitioners (applicants, attorneys/agents)
extracted.subtask_description: Revisions to the MPEP (Rev. 3, Aug 2005) describing procedural, filing, fee, representation, IDS, drawing, amendment, appeal, and reexamination rules and examiner handling guidance for U.S. patent prosecution before the USPTO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment of basic filing, search, and examination fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Basic filing fee, search fee and examination fee are referenced and required; for nonprovisional applications filed on or after December 8, 2004, search and examination fees set forth in 37 CFR 1.16 are required in addition to the basic filing fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For applications filed on or after July 1, 2005, if any of the basic filing fee, search fee or examination fee are paid on a date later than the filing date of the application, a surcharge is required (37 CFR 1.16(f)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Elimination of processing and retention fee practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective July 1, 2005, the processing and retention fee practice has been eliminated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The basic filing fee, rather than just the processing and retention fee, must be paid within the pendency of a nonprovisional application in order to permit benefit of the application to be claimed under 35 U.S.C. 120 in a subsequent application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claiming benefit of prior application (35 U.S.C. 120/121/365(c))
rubrics_metrics.description: If applicant wishes to claim the benefit of a prior application under 35 U.S.C. 120, 121 or 365(c), applicant must include a reference to the prior application in compliance with 37 CFR 1.78(a) in the first sentence(s) of the specification or in an ADS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiners should review the front page identifying data to ensure accuracy of all prior applications for which benefits are claimed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incorporation by reference (37 CFR 1.57)
rubrics_metrics.description: Discussion regarding incorporation by reference revised to reflect 37 CFR 1.57; material on explicit incorporation by reference codified in 37 CFR 1.57(b)-(g) with a few changes tied to 18-month publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See new MPEP § 201.17 for incorporation by reference under 37 CFR 1.57(a); when applicable, form paragraphs and cross-references updated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preliminary amendments on filing date
rubrics_metrics.description: For applications filed on or after September 21, 2004, a preliminary amendment present on the filing date of the application is part of the original disclosure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a preliminary amendment contains subject matter not otherwise included in the specification and drawings and the oath/declaration does not refer to the preliminary amendment, applicant must provide a supplemental oath/declaration referring to it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assignment recordation requirements (37 CFR 3.28 / 3.11)
rubrics_metrics.description: Assignment records of the USPTO will reflect an assignment of an application (including divisional or continuation) only if a request for recordation in compliance with 37 CFR 3.28 (with required fee) is filed; for a patent to issue to an assignee the assignment must have been recorded or filed for recordation in accordance with 37 CFR 3.11.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assignment records for published applications are available on the USPTO web site; documents submitted for recordation will not be returned; electronic submission of assignment documents added.

rubrics_metrics.name: Joint research agreement recording (37 CFR 3.11(c))
rubrics_metrics.description: 37 CFR 3.11(c) related to joint research agreements added per the Cooperative Research and Technology Enhancement Act of 2004.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Added discussion of information required in the cover sheet used to record a joint research agreement; updated Form PTO-1595.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cover sheet and assignment document correction procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Corrective assignment document must include a copy of the original assignment with corrections; typographical errors made by the Office will be corrected promptly and without charge; for other errors the party recording the document is responsible for correction and fees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New sections added addressing typographical errors in cover sheet, in recorded assignment document, assignment or change of name improperly filed by another person, and expungement of assignment records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic submission and e-IDS via EFS
rubrics_metrics.description: New sections address electronic submission of assignment documents and e-IDS using EFS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures and requirements for e-IDS and electronic filing updated (see MPEP sections on IDS and EFS).

rubrics_metrics.name: Power of attorney practice changes
rubrics_metrics.description: Revisions reflect that associate power of attorney practice has been eliminated effective June 25, 2004; a power of attorney naming more than ten practitioners will only be entered if Customer Number practice is used or accompanied by a separate paper indicating which ten are to be recognized.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form PTO/SB/81 updated; references to 37 CFR 11.9 and 1.36 incorporated; sample 'Authorization to Act in a Representative Capacity' added.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correspondence address and Customer Number precedence
rubrics_metrics.description: If more than one correspondence address is specified in a single document, the Office will use the address associated with a Customer Number over a typed correspondence address.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If an attorney/agent of record assigns a correspondence address different from practitioner's normal mail address, practitioner must keep client information confidential per 37 CFR 10.57.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restrictions on non-registered representatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Non-registered representatives of the practitioner of record should not be telephoned for restriction requirements, approval of examiner's amendments or given any information relative to the application even if authorized by the practitioner of record.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Protects confidentiality and proper communications channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: USPTO employee inventors' oath/declaration restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: Employees of the USPTO who were inventors are not permitted to sign an oath or declaration for patent application during their employment and one year thereafter; treated as unavailable for purposes of 37 CFR 1.47.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These employees will be treated as being unavailable to sign the oath/declaration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling of petitions and Office of Petitions referrals
rubrics_metrics.description: When an examiner receives an application in which a petition under 37 CFR 1.47 has been filed, examiner must check if petition is decided by Office of Petitions; if undecided, forward application or electronic message to Office of Petitions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses petition workflow and dependencies for decision before examiner action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mailing and filing address updates and EFS acceptance
rubrics_metrics.description: Mailing addresses for certain correspondences and the Customer Service Window updated; new utility and provisional applications can be filed via EFS; certain petitions may be faxed to Office of Petitions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists updated addresses and which submissions may be hand-delivered or faxed; central fax number updated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of acceptable signatures
rubrics_metrics.description: Three types of signature: handwritten, s-signature, and EFS character coded signature; added subsections addressing certifications and ratifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form paragraphs revised to reflect acceptable signature types and handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of insufficient payment at filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures regarding situations where payment submitted for fees due on filing is insufficient and applicant has not specified the fees to which payment is to be applied.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Office will treat insufficient payments according to updated rules; see MPEP section updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deposit account and elimination of credit card replenishment
rubrics_metrics.description: Revised to indicate how Office will treat deposit account authorization to charge certain fees; use of credit cards to replenish deposit accounts has been eliminated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses Deposit Account Division contact info and procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Security interest not equivalent to transfer of rights absent default
rubrics_metrics.description: A security interest does not involve an obligation to transfer rights in the invention for purposes of 37 CFR 1.27(a)(1)-(3) unless the security interest is defaulted upon.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies when security interests constitute a transfer of rights for duty-of-disclosure and related matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Return of replacement drawings and identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Each drawing sheet submitted after the filing date must be identified as either 'Replacement Sheet' or 'New Sheet.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In IFW applications generally the most recently filed drawings will be used for printing unless indicated 'Not Entered.' Also, sequence listing/table not permitted to be reprinted in drawings (with 371 exceptions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstract length
rubrics_metrics.description: Abstract should not exceed 15 lines of text.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form paragraphs revised accordingly (37 CFR 1.77 updates).

rubrics_metrics.name: Tables and drawings duplication prohibition
rubrics_metrics.description: Tables included in the description portion of the specification must not be included in both the drawings and the description; applications filed under 35 U.S.C. 371 are excluded from this prohibition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure tables are only present in one location to avoid duplication in print/formatted output.

rubrics_metrics.name: CD-R submission requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: CD-R discs must be finalized so that they are closed to further writing; tables in landscape orientation should be identified as landscape in accompanying transmittal letter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filings without identification of landscape mode will be rendered as portrait by the Office; form paragraphs updated for CD-R handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: IDS content and timing requirements (new sections 609.04, 609.05)
rubrics_metrics.description: New sections direct content requirements for an IDS, timing requirements for filing an IDS, examiner handling of IDSs, IDSs in continuing and national stage applications, and e-IDS via EFS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes an examiner checklist for IDSs, handling of noncomplying IDSs, and documents submitted as part of applicant's reply to an Office action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiner handling of applicant-known facts (37 CFR 1.105)
rubrics_metrics.description: Pursuant to 37 CFR 1.105, it is facts and factual information, known to applicant or readily obtained after reasonable inquiry, that are required to be reported — not opinions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No need for applicants to distinguish between unknown vs not readily available; if unknown after reasonable inquiry applicant may state that the requested information is either unknown or not readily available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reasonable inquiry examples and requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Added examples of information that may be reasonably required under 37 CFR 1.105 and guidance on reasonable inquiry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form paragraphs revised; illustrative examples added to guide applicants and examiners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rejections under 35 U.S.C. 101 (utility)
rubrics_metrics.description: A rejection under 35 U.S.C. 101 for lack of utility should not be based on grounds that the invention is frivolous, fraudulent or against public policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Added discussion of Federal Circuit decision providing boundaries for utility rejections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obviation of double patenting rejections under CREATE Act and terminal disclaimer
rubrics_metrics.description: Added discussion regarding 35 U.S.C. 103(c) as amended by the CREATE Act; for double patenting rejections based on a non-commonly owned patent (treated as commonly owned pursuant to CREATE Act), the double patenting rejection may be obviated by filing a terminal disclaimer in accordance with 37 CFR 1.321(d).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a reference is disqualified under joint research agreement provision and a new double patenting rejection is applied, next Office action containing the new double patenting rejection may be made final under limited conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment timing and entry (after allowance / issue fee)
rubrics_metrics.description: Since amendments are not permitted after payment of the issue fee, a petition under 37 CFR 1.182 to change inventor name/order cannot be granted if filed after payment of the issue fee; amendments filed prior to mailing notice of allowance but received after mailing may not be approved for entry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Options when name change petitions cannot be granted after issue fee: withdraw application from issue and file RCE or file certificate of correction after patent issues; amendments under 37 CFR 1.312 after allowance have to comply with 1.121 and may be corrected by examiner’s amendment if appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Excess claims fees and when payable
rubrics_metrics.description: Added discussion regarding basic filing fee, search fee, examination fee, application size fee, and excess claims fees; where applicant adds new excess claim in excess of previously paid claims, the required excess claims fees must be paid before examiner considers the new claim.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If amendment adds claims to a patent/reexamination then excess claims fees may apply; new MPEP sections on excess claims fees added (e.g., 2250.03, 2666.04).

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendments in inter partes reexamination and timing limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Pursuant to 37 CFR 1.116(d)(1), no amendment other than canceling claims (that does not affect scope of other pending claims) can be made in an inter partes reexamination proceeding after the RAN except as provided in 37 CFR 1.981 or permitted by 37 CFR 41.77(b)(1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Various reexamination sections updated to reflect transfer procedures, CRU processes, forms, and co-pending proceedings with reissue.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reexamination procedural updates (CRU, public PAIR, e-File)
rubrics_metrics.description: Added reference to Central Reexamination Unit (CRU); reexamination files are open to inspection via Public PAIR; reexamination e-File discussed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for transfer, merger with reissue, handling multiple requests and subsequent requests raising substantial new question of patentability updated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling supplemental replies and submissions during suspension
rubrics_metrics.description: A supplemental reply is not entered as a matter of right unless filed during a suspension period under 37 CFR 1.103(a) or (c); added discussion of supplemental replies under 1.111 and 1.550, and applications of 37 CFR 1.8(b) for previous mailing/transmission notices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form paragraphs updated; guidance on when supplemental replies are entered and their effect on prosecution timing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedures for withdrawing from issue / letter of express abandonment
rubrics_metrics.description: A letter of express abandonment or petition under 37 CFR 1.138(c) to avoid publication may be mailed or faxed; if submitted after payment of issue fee it must be accompanied by a petition to withdraw from issue under 37 CFR 1.313(c) and appropriate fee, and is only effective if received/granted before date of issue.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses timing and effectiveness of withdrawal requests and updated addresses for Office of Petitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendments and examiner’s amendments handling (37 CFR 1.121/1.114)
rubrics_metrics.description: Revised discussions concerning amendments to claims and drawings, examiner's amendments, non-compliant amendments, defective directions for entry of an amendment, and amendment of amendments; added subsections for examiner's amendments and non-compliant amendments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes updated flowcharts, forms (e.g., PTOL-324), and guidance on entry of amendments and handling non-compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling of responses too long / defective submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Where failure to comply with notice of defective paper results in patent owner failing to file timely response, prosecution may be terminated or limited under 37 CFR 1.957(b) or (c); added examples and flow for defective submissions in reexamination context.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Added form PTOL-475 and examples illustrating defective submissions and inspector handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeals and new appeal rules references
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple sections revised to add references to the new appeal rules (Board/appeal procedures) and updates to flowcharts and forms for appeals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiner and reexamination procedures updated to reflect new appeal rules, including handling of submissions after appeal (37 CFR 41.33) and timing for briefs (37 CFR 41.37).
